nodes.description: SSTK._name: token name string, set to 'Sustain Token' in constructor and read by name().
SSTK._symbol: token symbol string, set to 'SSTK' in constructor and read by symbol().
SSTK._decimals: token decimals, set to 18 in constructor and read by decimals().
ERC20._totalSupply: total token supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
ERC20._balances: mapping(address => uint256) of holder balances, modified by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
ERC20._allowances: nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of spenders approvals, written by _approve.
SSTK constructor(address payable feeReceiver) payable: sets metadata, mints the entire 1e15 * 1e18 supply to msg.sender and forwards msg.value to feeReceiver.
SSTK.burn(uint256 value) public: destroys value tokens from msg.sender via _burn.
SSTK.name(): returns the _name state variable.
SSTK.symbol(): returns the _symbol state variable.
SSTK.decimals(): returns the _decimals state variable.
ERC20.totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply.
ERC20.balanceOf(address account): returns _balances[account].
ERC20.transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount): invokes _transfer(msg.sender, recipient, amount).
ERC20.allowance(address owner, address spender): returns _allowances[owner][spender].
ERC20.approve(address spender, uint256 value): invokes _approve(msg.sender, spender, value).
ERC20.transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount): moves tokens and deducts the caller allowance via SafeMath.sub.
ERC20.increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue): raises allowance using SafeMath.add.
ERC20.decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue): lowers allowance using SafeMath.sub.
ERC20._transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount): internal balance-moving routine with zero-address requires and a Transfer event.
ERC20._mint(address account, uint256 amount): internal mint that increases _totalSupply and _balances[account].
ERC20._burn(address account, uint256 value): internal burn that decreases _totalSupply and _balances[account].
ERC20._approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 value): writes _allowances and emits Approval.
ERC20._burnFrom(address account, uint256 amount): burns and deducts the caller allowance.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for minting, burning, transfers and approvals.
feeReceiver.transfer(msg.value): external ETH value transfer to a caller-supplied payable address inside the constructor.
_mint(msg.sender, 1000000000000000 * (10**18)): mints an enormous 1e33 token supply to the deployer without cap or vesting.
Constructor parameter feeReceiver (address payable): destination of the deployment service fee.
SSTK.burn parameter value (uint256): amount of tokens to destroy.
ERC20.transfer parameter recipient (address): token receiver.
ERC20.transfer parameter amount (uint256): tokens to move.
ERC20.transferFrom parameter sender (address): account whose tokens are moved.
ERC20.transferFrom parameter recipient (address): token receiver.
ERC20.transferFrom parameter amount (uint256): tokens to move and allowance to deduct.
ERC20.approve parameter spender (address): address granted the allowance.
ERC20.approve parameter value (uint256): allowance amount set.
ERC20._transfer parameter sender (address): debit side of the balance move.
ERC20._transfer parameter recipient (address): credit side of the balance move.
ERC20._transfer parameter amount (uint256): value moved between balances.
ERC20._mint parameter account (address): recipient of newly created tokens.
ERC20._mint parameter amount (uint256): number of tokens created.
ERC20._burn parameter account (address): holder whose tokens are destroyed.
ERC20._burn parameter value (uint256): number of tokens destroyed.

edges.reason: Deployer-supplied feeReceiver parameter is read by the SSTK constructor during deployment.
burn value parameter flows into _burn as the amount of tokens destroyed from the caller.
transfer recipient parameter flows into _transfer as the credit account.
transfer amount parameter flows into _transfer as the moved value.
transferFrom sender parameter determines whose balance is debited.
transferFrom recipient parameter determines whose balance is credited.
transferFrom amount parameter is moved and deducted from the caller allowance.
approve spender parameter receives the allowance set by _approve.
approve value parameter becomes the stored allowance.
_transfer sender parameter is the debited account.
_transfer recipient parameter is the credited account.
_transfer amount parameter is the value moved between balances.
_mint account parameter receives the newly created tokens.
_mint amount parameter is added to _totalSupply and to the holder balance.
_burn account parameter is the holder whose balance is reduced.
_burn value parameter is subtracted from _totalSupply and the holder balance.
Constructor executes _mint(msg.sender, 1000000000000000 * (10**18)), creating a fixed supply through multiplication of literal amounts.
Constructor performs the external value transfer feeReceiver.transfer(msg.value).
The constructor feeReceiver parameter is the recipient of the ETH service fee, making the external transfer destination deployer-controlled.
msg.sender is credited with the entire initial token supply by _mint.
burn forwards msg.sender to _burn as the account whose tokens are destroyed.
burn(value) calls _burn(msg.sender, value).
transfer(recipient, amount) calls _transfer(msg.sender, recipient, amount).
msg.sender is passed as the sender argument of _transfer from transfer and transferFrom paths.
approve(spender, value) calls _approve(msg.sender, spender, value).
msg.sender is passed as the owner argument of _approve.
transferFrom(sender, recipient, amount) calls _transfer(sender, recipient, amount).
transferFrom calls _approve(sender, msg.sender, _allowances[sender][msg.sender].sub(amount)).
msg.sender supplies the allowance spend key in transferFrom.
increaseAllowance calls _approve(msg.sender, spender, existing.add(addedValue)).
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner in increaseAllowance.
decreaseAllowance calls _approve(msg.sender, spender, existing.sub(subtractedValue)).
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner in decreaseAllowance.
_burnFrom(account, amount) calls _burn(account, amount).
_burnFrom then calls _approve(account, msg.sender, allowance.sub(amount)).
msg.sender identifies the spender whose allowance is reduced inside _burnFrom.
_transfer debits _balances[sender] and credits _balances[recipient].
_mint increases _totalSupply by amount.
_mint credits _balances[account] by amount.
_burn decreases _totalSupply by value.
_burn debits _balances[account] by value.
_approve stores value in _allowances[owner][spender].
name() reads and returns the _name state variable.
symbol() reads and returns the _symbol state variable.
decimals() reads and returns the _decimals state variable.
totalSupply() reads and returns _totalSupply.
balanceOf(account) reads _balances[account].
allowance(owner, spender) reads _allowances[owner][spender].

normalization_plan.reason: feeReceiver only exists to define the destination of feeReceiver.transfer(msg.value), so it can be folded into that unsafe external transfer operation.
burn value is the sole argument of SSTK.burn and is directly forwarded to _burn, so it normalizes into the burn function node.
recipient is only used by ERC20.transfer when forwarding to _transfer, so it collapses into the transfer function.
amount is only used by ERC20.transfer when forwarding to _transfer, so it collapses into the transfer function.
sender is consumed by transferFrom for the balance move and allowance lookup, so it normalizes into transferFrom.
recipient is consumed by transferFrom for the credit side of the balance move, so it normalizes into transferFrom.
amount is consumed by transferFrom for the move and the SafeMath allowance deduction, so it normalizes into transferFrom.
spender is only used by ERC20.approve when calling _approve, so it collapses into the approve function.
value is only used by ERC20.approve when calling _approve, so it collapses into the approve function.
sender is read and written inside _balances by _transfer, so it normalizes into the _transfer function node.
recipient is credited inside _balances by _transfer, so it normalizes into the _transfer function node.
amount is added to and subtracted from balances by _transfer, so it normalizes into the _transfer function node.
account is the credited holder in _mint and is only meaningful inside that function.
amount is added to _totalSupply and _balances by _mint and is only meaningful inside that function.
account is the debited holder in _burn and is only meaningful inside that function.
value is subtracted from _totalSupply and _balances by _burn and is only meaningful inside that function.
